newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sharp to invest 90 to 100 bln yen in new LCD plant.
newsitem.headline: Sharp to invest 90 to 100 bln yen in new LCD plant.

text.p: Sharp Corp said on Tuesday that it expected to invest 90 to 100 billion yen in a second liquid crystal display (LCD) plant to be built at its complex in Mie prefecture, central Japan.

Sharp plans to invest 50 billion yen in the first phase of the project and an additional 40 to 50 billion yen in the second phase, a company spokesman quoted Sharp Vice-President Atsushi Asada as saying.
Asada made the remarks at a news conference held in Osaka earlier on Tuesday, the spokesman said.

Earlier on Tuesday, Sharp said it planned to spend 15 billion yen to construct the building that would house the project. The spokesman said that amount was included in the first phase of the project.
Sharp said the first phase of the new plant was expected to start production in October 1998.

After the completion of the first phase, the new plant will have production capacity equivalent to the first Mie plant, which is expected to produce 250,000 LCDs per month in the six months to March 31, 1998, the spokesman said.
The spokesman said that details of the new plant's second phase, including final production capacity, have not yet been decided.
